correctness.rationale: For f^2=e_S all elements of S are fixed; injectivity forbids other fixed points and moving images in the domain. Fixed points separate the map into independent gaps and the ordered domain/image encoding is a bijection onto Motzkin words. Exact gap products and generating function follow. The explicit Motzkin radical has unique dominant square-root point z=1/3; all factorial moments scaled by n^(r/2) converge to those of Rayleigh(sqrt(2/3)), which is moment-determinate. Direct independent enumeration of all 23,713 maps for n<=9 and 1,023 idempotent fibers, plus coefficients through n=29, returned VERIFY_OK. No finite check is substituted for proof.

originality.rationale: Novelty is assessed for the complete prescribed-idempotent square-root fiber product and conditioned Rayleigh limit, not for the known unweighted Motzkin INVERT sequence. The inspected 2023 monoid paper treats finite basis; the 2024 quasi-idempotent paper treats shift-one generation, Green relations and ideal ranks; neither inspected relevant results enumerates all square fibers. OEIS A005773 independently covers the scalar total count, acknowledged without claiming priority. Broader transformation-semigroup and mathematical-claim searches found no result with equivalent fiber implications; remaining old thesis and 2015 full-article access risk is explicitly retained.

value.rationale: The natural semigroup equation f^2=e_S has a complete, exact, geometry-sensitive classification for every idempotent. For n=4, e_{1} and e_{4} each have 4 square roots but e_{2} and e_{3} have only 2, proving idempotent rank alone does not determine the fiber. A conditional Rayleigh sqrt(n)-scale law and an explicit exponential rarity estimate characterize a mathematically natural power-defined stratum. This is more than an arbitrary numerical slice, even though the scalar total sequence is known.
